title: Soundtrack of My Life
description: A data viz experiment in self-exploration — years of collected listening turned into a living map of taste, memory, and time. Orbit through decades of music and watch the archive rearrange itself into shapes that feel like a diary you can navigate.

title: Moving Photon
description: Interactive installation and performance collaboration with Friendred Peng — Phantom performance, EEG-driven interaction, and a remote performance experience.

title: Glitch Machine
description: A custom glitch app built for Jenna Marsh — play with an image, apply different filters, and export the result for printing.

title: Noizu
description: Custom audio player for Linux and Mac — a light, simple player inspired by Sonique and Winamp, when UI and UX were actually interesting and different.

title: YaEsta.com
description: Physical interactive installation with video mapping projected onto the tallest building in Quito for the launch of YaEsta.com. Also part of the tech team managing the platform until acquisition.
